subject: Dedicated pool term & phased start options — BlueRidge Systems
messages:
From: Andrea Moss <andrea.moss@blueridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@blueridge.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool inquiry and timeline

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Carlos and I walked away impressed with Redwood's latency and the routing/fallback story. We're evaluating a Dedicated GPU pool for our inference platform and want to understand how term length, start date flexibility, and ramp milestones affect pricing and guarantees. A few specifics from our side:

- Target footprint: supporting ~150k monthly active inference requests initially, avg payload ~3–4k tokens; peak burst expected during nightly batches.
- Preferred start window: we'd like to start using capacity in November (budget timing), but are open to committing earlier if there's a meaningful credit or invoice deferral.
- Term preference: procurement will push for a 12 or 24 month reserved commit; 36 months is a hard ask only if the economics are compelling.
- Requests: pricing tables by 12/24/36 month term with discount level, an explicit ramp schedule (month-by-month expected utilization and invoice milestones), and whether Redwood can provide credit (token or dollar) if start is delayed past an agreed start date. Also need baseline throughput guarantees (RPS for 4k token requests) and details on burst behavior and overage pricing.

Can you share an initial package and any standard contract language around start/activation credits and SLA? I'll pull in procurement after we have options.

Best,
Andrea Moss
Head of Platform Procurement
BlueRidge Systems

---
Attachments: none in this note
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Andrea Moss <andrea.moss@blueridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool inquiry and timeline

Andrea —

Appreciate the clear ask. I've attached a short pricing workbook (BlueRidge_Pricing_Options_v3.xlsx) and a rough throughput model (Throughput_Modeling.xlsx) that map SKU + GPU pool sizing to latency/throughput estimates for 3–4k token requests. High level options below — these are meant to be starting points we can refine after you confirm expected QPS and model mix.

Option A — 12 month reserved commit
- 10% off posted Dedicated list for the agreed GPU pool size
- No start credit; activation must occur within 60 days of contract signature
- Soft-start ramp: months 1–2 at 40% baseline, month 3 at 75%, full capacity month 4

Option B — 24 month reserved commit (recommended for balance of flexibility & savings)
- 20% off posted list
- 1 month credit (applied to first invoice) if activation is delayed to Nov as requested
- Soft-start ramp: months 1–2 at 50% baseline, month 3 at 80%
- Baseline throughput guarantee: 250 RPS for 4k token avg (sustained), with a documented burst policy (up to 2x baseline for 30 minutes, subject to burst pool availability)

Option C — 36 month reserved commit
- 28% off posted list + additional unit credit on committed tokens
- 2 month credit if start delayed up to 90 days after signature
- Higher priority on capacity and bespoke SLA

Notes / asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether you need a hard commitment to start in Nov or if a signed contract with a delayed activation window works? That determines whether we apply the credit.
- Which inference model(s) are you planning to serve (open LLMs vs. large private fine-tuned models)? Different models change KV-cache sizing and effective throughput.

I've attached Draft_MA-BlueRidge-v2.pdf as a starting mark for commercial terms. Karthik/Marissa — flagged for pool sizing and SLA input.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: BlueRidge_Pricing_Options_v3.xlsx (pricing workbook); Draft_MA-BlueRidge-v2.pdf (commercial draft); Throughput_Modeling.xlsx

Date: 2026-08-02T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool term & phased start options — BlueRidge Systems

Kimberly —

Thanks, that is helpful. A couple of clarifications from procurement:

- Our finance team will require invoice terms that match our fiscal year; if we sign in August but activation happens in November we need the first invoice dated Nov with the credit applied — is that possible?
- For commercial leverage the execs prefer a 24 month term, but they asked if Redwood can bump to 22%+ for a 24 month if we agree to a 2-month soft-start credit and a 60-day invoice deferral window.
- SLA: procurement will expect a 99.9% availability SLO for the Dedicated pool. Please confirm whether that is standard or needs an addendum.

If you can push back with the maximum concession you can make without getting legal fully involved, we can accelerate.

With thanks,
Andrea

Attachment: BlueRidge_Internal_POs.pdf (internal reference)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: (internal only)
Date: 2026-08-03T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool term & phased start options — BlueRidge Systems

Kim / Marissa —

Quick sizing + commercial math based on BlueRidge's numbers (150k MAU, 3–4k tokens avg):
- Recommended baseline pool: 4 x A100-80GB equivalence (or 6 x L40 class) for steady 250 RPS at ~200ms tail latency for 4k token requests assuming quantized FP16 runtime.
- Burst pool: 2 x additional GPUs reserved as a burst tier (billed at lower discount) to cover daily batch spikes.

Commercially: 24 months gives the best economics and preserves flexibility. My margin-preserving concessions:
- 24 months at 20% is our baseline sell; we can stretch to 22% (one-point bump) if we require a smaller billing concession:
  - Offer 22% off list AND a 2-month activation credit (credit applies to invoices starting at activation date)
  - Invoice deferral: allow first invoice dated to activation (Nov) if contract executed earlier, but require signed PO showing intent to start by Nov 15 to enable deferral.
- SLA: 99.9% can be offered for Dedicated with standard credits on a per-minute outage SLA schedule in the MA. Anything needing higher availability/financials goes to Legal for escalation.

Risk notes: credits + higher discount reduce near-term revenue. Recommend attaching a 30% overage rate for burst if usage exceeds the agreed burst cap to protect capacity. Also include an explicit ramp milestone schedule with telemetry gates (e.g., activation call + NRT test, week 4 steady-state).

If Kimberly is okay, I'll draft a short commercial amendment we can attach to the MA and send a clean DocuSign.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Andrea / Carlos —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and clarity on procurement needs. Based on Karthik's sizing and our internal review, here's a concise commercial proposal we can agree to before I route to Legal for a clean MA amendment:

Offer (Preferred): 24 month reserved commit
- Discount: 22% off Redwood Dedicated list pricing for the agreed GPU pool (applies to committed tokens and baseline capacity)
- Activation credit: 2 months of service credit applied to invoices after activation (activation = when BlueRidge first hits production traffic on the Dedicated pool)
- Invoice timing: if contract is signed before Nov 15 and you confirm activation target of Nov, Redwood will date the first invoice to activation (Nov) and apply the activation credit per above
- Baseline throughput guarantee: 250 RPS for 4k token avg (sustained) with 99.9% availability SLO; SLA credit schedule attached in MA amendment
- Burst policy: up to 2x baseline for short windows (30 minutes). Bursts beyond the burst pool cap billed as overage at a pre-agreed rate (30% over committed unit price)
- Pool sizing: baseline described as 4 x A100-80GB equivalence; final sizing to be validated during onboarding performance tests

Alternative: 12 month term at 12% discount with no activation credit (for execs pressing for shorter tenure).

Next steps:
1) If you confirm the 24 month / 22% option I will: a) attach a 1-page commercial amendment to the Draft_MA-BlueRidge-v2.pdf, b) generate a DocuSign and send it to your procurement.
2) Karthik will schedule a 60-min perf validation call during onboarding to lock final GPU SKU choices.
